The best I can find is a button at the menu bar, which can't pause or scrub easily. Luckily Brackeys (of gamedev tutorial fame) had done a simple plugin that puts up a viewport UI to control particle spawning similarly to Unity. I would highly recommend getting this until Godot adds something natively. https://github.com/Brackeys/brackey…
